meta.name: agenthub
meta.description: Multi-agent collaboration plugin that spawns N parallel subagents competing on the same task via git worktree isolation. Agents work independently, results are evaluated by metric or LLM judge, and the best branch is merged. Use when: user wants multiple approaches tried in parallel — code optimization, content variation, research exploration, or any task that benefits from parallel competition. Requires: a git repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个子代理竞争同一任务，自动合并最优结果
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple subagents in parallel on the same task and auto-merge the best result
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multiple approaches tried in parallel and the best one automatically merged

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可把同一任务拆给多个互不可见的子代理,在各自独立的 git worktree 里并行做;完成后按指标或由 LLM 评判排名,再把得分最高的分支合并回主分支。
howto.when: 当用户说“尝试多种方法”“让代理竞争”“并行优化”等,或要求并行探索多种方案时触发;前提是当前项目是一个 git 仓库。

say.text: 请用多个代理并行尝试不同的优化方案,最后合并最好的。
say.note: 会初始化会话并生成多个隔离分支。

say.text: 开 4 个竞争代理,分别写不同文案,按质量打分。
say.note: 可用 /hub:eval 或让 Claude 评判。

say.text: 对比三种重构思路,跑测试后留下通过且改动最少的一个。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can split one task among N hidden subagents, each working in an isolated git worktree. Results are ranked by metric or LLM judge, and the winning branch is merged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to try multiple approaches, have agents compete, parallel-optimize, generate variants, or similar; requires an existing git repo.

say_en.text: Try several optimization approaches in parallel with agents and merge the best one.
say_en.note: Creates a session and isolated branches.

say_en.text: Spawn 4 competing agents to draft different copy and rank by quality.
Compare three refactoring plans, run tests, and keep the smallest passing change.
